cases.detail: Reviewers sometimes ask for semantic diffs that ignore formatting churn. Comparison can normalize whitespace, but displayed hunk lines should remain original text.
cases.title: whitespace mode

cases.detail: Editor integrations use one-based line numbers. Raw SequenceMatcher indexes are zero-based, so hunk starts need adjustment after context expansion.
cases.title: one based starts

cases.detail: Each change should include nearby equal lines on both old and new sides. Context helps reviewers understand a compact hunk without opening the full file.
cases.title: context expansion

cases.detail: Two changes close together should appear as one hunk when their context overlaps. Separate overlapping hunks duplicate lines and confuse review comments.
cases.title: merged windows

cases.detail: The same hunk format should support replacements, insertions, and deletions by allowing either side's line list to be empty after context is considered.
cases.title: insertions and deletions

notes: These notes are not executed directly; the unittest suite is the scorer.
They are included so agents can practice selecting relevant context.
A correct implementation should be deterministic across repeated runs.
title: Line Diff Reporter
